$comment: Recorded from the plugin's own handler table with the pinned engine and models present: a tools-only plugin with no accounts, no sources and no bus events.
namespace: Local voice: report the speech engine, models, microphone and next step, and speak text aloud on this machine. Dictation happens in the terminal UI, not through a tool. Audio stays on this machine and no recording is kept. Not for transcribing an audio file (a collector plugin) or meetings.
